Frequently Asked Questions (Dubai Freezone Setup)

SHAMS (Sharjah Media City) and RAKEZ (Ras Al Khaimah) offer the lowest 0-visa license costs starting around AED 8,900 – AED 9,400. In Dubai, Meydan Free Zone (from AED 12,500) and IFZA (from AED 12,900) are the most popular choices for tech startups and consultants.
